//In the Name of God

#include <bits/stdc++.h>

#define err(A) cout << #A << " = " << (A) << endl

#define int long long

using namespace std;

const int maxn = 512;

int n, m, M;

int c[maxn][maxn];
int p[maxn][maxn];

int me, you;

int g(int a, int b)
{
  if (!b)
    return 1;
  return p[a + 1][b - 1] * p[2][b] %M * (a + 1 - b) %M;
}

int32_t main()
{
  ios::sync_with_stdio(0); cin.tie(0);

  cin >> n >> m >> M;
  
  for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i ++)
    for (int j = 0; j <= i; j ++)
      if (j)
	c[i][j] = (c[i - 1][j] + c[i - 1][j - 1]) % M;
      else
	c[i][j] = 1;

  for (int i = 0; i < maxn; i ++)
    for (int j = 0; j < maxn; j ++)
      if (j)
	p[i][j] = p[i][j - 1] * i % M;
      else
	p[i][j] = 1;

  for (int i = 2; i <= m; i ++)
    for (int d = 1; d < i; d ++)  
      {
	me = d * (d + 1) / 2 * c[i - 1][d] %M * p[d + 1][d - 1] %M * g(n + 1 - (d + 1) - 1, i - (d + 1)) %M * p[2][d] %M * p[n + 1][m - i] %M * p[2][m - i] %M;
	you = (you + me + me) % M;
      }

  cout << you * (n + 1 - m) % M << endl;

  return 0;
}
